title: Auto-PRE: An Automatic and Cost-Efficient Peer-Review Framework for Language Generation Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Swapping the order of candidate answers in the evaluation prompt to measure whether the LLM evaluator's preference remains consistent regardless of the answers' positions.

Comparing the LLM evaluator's preference rates for answers generated by models from the same model family (e.g., GPT-4 evaluating GPT-3.5-turbo) against ground-truth human annotations to detect unfair favoritism.

Testing whether the evaluator LLM prioritizes superficial text quality (e.g., formatting, writing style) over actual pertinence by presenting irrelevant but well-written answers against highly relevant but lower-superficial-quality answers.
